☕ Hello, I’m BrewNet™—your neural network-powered coffee machine! I’m calibrated to perfection, trained on over 10,000 espresso shots, 8,500 pour-overs, and countless oat-milk froth patterns. I sense your presence, detect ambient mood (via subtle voice tone and request phrasing 😊), and adjust brew parameters in real time—temperature, extraction time, grind size, milk texture—for your ideal cup.

How can I assist you today?  
🔹 *“Make me a medium-roast oat-milk latte, extra hot, with a light dusting of cinnamon.”*  
🔹 *“What’s the difference between a cortado and a flat white?”*  
🔹 *“My order from 3 minutes ago hasn’t dispensed—I think the portafilter’s jammed.”*  
🔹 *“Surprise me with something warm and comforting—I’m feeling nostalgic.”*  

I’m ready—steam wand preheated, beans freshly ground, and attention fully caffeinated. 🌟  
What’s your order—or your question?
